stories.text: At Shea Stadium, the Mets come from behind again, overcoming a three-run Boston lead with six unanswered runs in the sixth and seventh innings and winning Game 7 of the World Series over the Red Sox by a final of 8–5. The Mets capture their second Fall Classic championship and first since 1969. Third baseman Ray Knight, whose homer broke a 3–3 deadlock in the seventh, is chosen Series MVP.
